notes.title: FREE New story set in the Tales from Candleforth universe.
notes.content:
[b][i]Wood and Flesh: A Candleforth Short Story[/i][/b] is a [u]free[/u] game that tells the first part of a new story set in the [i][b]Tales from Candleforth[/b][/i] universe.


A wooden piece of art. A carefully carved puppet.
But there's something missing... ♦️

Would you help fix it? 🧩

[h3]PLAY FOR FREE NOW!
[/h3]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3411660/Wood_and_Flesh_A_Candleforth_Short_Story/

notes.title: Tales From Candleforth Patch Notes (1.2.2.)
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes
[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a blank textbox froze the game if the player tried to leave the apothecary just after getting the first ingredient.
[*] Fixed some minor localization bugs (english, japanese, german, italian).
[/list]
